gloss: origin of a fire; source of a fire

definitions.gloss: origin of a fire; source of a fire
definitions.explanation: The point where a fire started, or the person or household responsible for causing a fire.

examples.japanese: {火元|ひもと}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧だった。
examples.english: The fire originated in the kitchen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{消防士|しょうぼうし}→消防士：05057_shouboushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{火元|ひもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べている→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: Firefighters are investigating the source of the fire.

examples.japanese: {火元|ひもと}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{住人|じゅうにん}→住人：11611_juunin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦コンロ→コンロ：04677_konro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{消|け}し→消す：00528_kesu⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The resident of the house where the fire originated testified that they forgot to turn off the stove.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧ (fire) + ⟦{元|もと}→元：03878_moto⟧ (origin, source). Used in fire investigation and news reports. Can refer to either the physical location where a fire started or the responsible party.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {火元|ひもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to investigate the source of a fire
- {火元|ひもと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}する→特定する：19642_tokuteisuru⟧: to identify the origin of a fire
- {火元|ひもと}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be the source of a fire
- {火元|ひもと}⟦{不明|ふめい}→不明：11352_fumei⟧: unknown origin of fire
- {火元|ひもと}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不注意|ふちゅうい}→不注意：15111_fuchuui⟧: carelessness at the source of fire

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出火|しゅっか}→出火：20260_shukka⟧: outbreak of fire — the event of a fire starting
- ⟦{火災|かさい}→火災：02561_kasai⟧: fire (disaster) — the fire itself as a disaster
- ⟦{火種|ひだね}→火種：13411_hidane⟧: spark, source of trouble — can be literal or figurative
